nodes.title: SG-5.3 · Exporter builds frozen-only JSON export
nodes.body:
Context: backend/internal/contribution already has the Export and ExportContribution types (export.go), the ExportSource interface with ListByRound and FrozenIDs (export_source.go), and FileStore.FrozenIDs (store.go). No exporter exists yet. Desired behavior: an Exporter builds an Export from the source, includes only contributions whose ids are frozen in the round snapshot, and returns an empty contributions list for an empty round. Why: the devion workseed handoff must receive only frozen contributions.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a source with contributions A, B, C and frozen ids A and C, When Export is called, Then Contributions holds exactly A and C
- Given a round with no frozen ids, When Export is called, Then Contributions is a non-nil empty slice that marshals to []


## Scope
- In scope: backend/internal/contribution exporter
- Out of scope: HTTP endpoints
- Out of scope: CLI
- Out of scope: worker or execution code
- Preserve: Export JSON types
- Preserve: ExportSource interface
- Preserve: FileStore behavior


## Technical constraints
- Go package contribution only; depend only on ExportSource
- No import of worker or execution packages


## Definition of done
- Exporter implemented and unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Exporter includes only frozen contributions in snapshot order
nodes.body:
Exporter reads ListByRound and FrozenIDs from an ExportSource and builds Export with Version ExportVersion, WorldID, RoundID and ExportContribution entries (ID, Author=PlayerID, Content=Prompt, CreatedAt) for frozen ids only, in the order FrozenIDs lists them.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given contributions A,B,C and frozen ids [C,A], When Export runs, Then Contributions IDs are [C,A]
- Given an unfrozen contribution B, When Export runs, Then B does not appear and fields map PlayerID to author and Prompt to content


## Scope
- In scope: Exporter type and Export method
- Out of scope: empty round handling beyond non-nil slice
- Preserve: export.go types


## Technical constraints
- Frozen ids absent from ListByRound are skipped


## Definition of done
- Frozen-only filtering behaves as specified


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Empty round yields an empty list and source errors propagate
nodes.body:
When the snapshot freezes no ids, or the round has no contributions, Export returns Contributions as an empty non-nil slice so JSON shows []. Errors from FrozenIDs (including ErrNotFound) and ListByRound are returned wrapped with %w.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given empty frozen ids, When Export runs, Then json.Marshal output contains "contributions":[]
- Given FrozenIDs returns ErrNotFound, When Export runs, Then errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) is true


## Scope
- In scope: empty-round and error paths of Export
- Out of scope: creating snapshots
- Preserve: Export JSON types


## Technical constraints
- Use fmt.Errorf with %w


## Definition of done
- Empty and error paths behave as specified


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Add Export(ctx context.Context, worldID, roundID string) (Export, error): call Source.ListByRound and Source.FrozenIDs, index the contributions by ID in a map, then for each frozen id in order append ExportContribution{ID: c.ID, Author: c.PlayerID, Content: c.Prompt, CreatedAt: c.CreatedAt} when present in the map; return Export{Version: ExportVersion, WorldID: worldID, RoundID: roundID, Contributions: out}
